Hello. We’re Teya . Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better. They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving.

Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business. Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support.

Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work. We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you What will you be doing? As we continue to expand our operations in the UK, we’re looking for our third Sales Manager to join our expanding Independent Sales Agent channel.

This is a fast paced, high velocity, transactional field team made up of freelance sellers. With the support of our dedicated recruitment team, you will be responsible for growing the team from 0 to ~60 people over the coming months and delivering our revenue goals.

Ultimately you will also be responsible for: Leading, managing and developing a dynamic team of commission-only sales representatives of varying levels of experience, ensuring alignment with company goals and objectives Working hands-on with the team, designing and implementing effective sales processes to drive revenue growth Providing initial training for new sellers and then ongoing mentorship to develop individuals and increase their volume of monthly sales Conduct regular reviews with individuals to ensure their continuous engagement with Teya and create a long-term partnership Collaborate with cross-functional teams including marketing and product development to act as a voice of the seller and ensure we have the best tools available to our team Analyse sales data and performance metrics to identify areas for improvement to increase channel growth What are we looking for?

Proven track record of successful field sales management experience, preferably in the payments industry or a related field Demonstratable experience of designing and implementing sales training for a variety of experience levels Strong leadership and team management skills with the ability to motivate and inspire a commission-only sales team to achieve and exceed targets Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategic sales plans that align with overall business objectives.

Proactive and results-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement and a willingness to take initiative in a dynamic and competitive market. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Knowledge of relevant industry trends, competitors, and market dynamics is preferable Ability to travel as needed to meet with sellers, attend industry events and support the sales team in various locations. What can we offer you?

On top of your basic salary you will be able to earn uncapped commissions 25 days of Annual Leave + Bank Holidays Physical and mental health support through our partnership with GymPass, 1-1 therapy sessions, meditation sessions and access to digital fitness and nutrition apps Extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices Private Medical and Life Insurance Improved pension Scheme Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

This is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales Teams.
Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.
Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers.

Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications.

We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company.

Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem.

We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries.

We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer.

This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward.

If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage.

You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance.

In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

Decile Group () is the leading agentic platform for fund administration. Our AI-native infrastructure lets emerging managers launch, run, and scale a VC fund without the overhead that used to make it impossible. We just closed two record-breaking quarters back to back.

Hundreds of managers have launched on our platform, and the pipeline keeps accelerating. Every fund admin platform your prospects have heard of was built before the agentic era. They run on manual reconciliation, junior staff, and siloed systems that don't talk to each other.

Their clients get slow K-1s, surprise invoices, and a back office that runs like it's 2015.
Decile was built differently. One data layer across legal, compliance, treasury, accounting, and LP management. AI handles the heavy lifting. Ultra-senior staff on every account. K-1s delivered in March when everyone else is still working on theirs in May. Institutional-grade operations at emerging manager scale.
Your prospects are out there funding AI companies. Their own operations should run like one. Decile is built for 2026 and beyond. That's the story you get to tell.

VC Lab and Decile Group never conduct hiring interviews via chat, and we will never ask candidates to send money, purchase equipment, or share financial information. You own a territory. You find emerging fund managers, show them what a modern fund operation actually looks like, and close them. Full sales cycle, no handoffs, uncapped commission.
The product line runs from Start Fund for first-time managers to full migrations for funds ready to move off legacy platforms. Migrations are the highest-value deals and close at near 100%. Self-sourced deals earn a bonus on top of the base rate.
We just closed two record-breaking quarters. The market is moving our way.

You will be on the front lines of a genuine market shift. Every day you are talking to GPs who are running their funds on platforms built before AI existed, paying too much, getting too little, and in many cases not even knowing a better option exists.
Your job is to find them, wake them up, and bring them over.
You prospect hard, get GPs on the phone, and show them what it looks like when a fund runs the way the companies they invest in actually run. You own the full cycle from cold outreach to signed contract. No committee, no handoffs. When you close, you close.

You know the VC and emerging manager ecosystem. You understand fund structures, what GPs actually deal with day to day, and why a back office that runs badly is a real problem.
You are genuinely agentic. You build your own pipeline, use every tool available including AI, and figure out what works without waiting to be told. You have probably been a first sales hire somewhere or built something yourself.

s.t:
Prospection et développement de portefeuille : C'est le cœur de ta mission. Tu construis et gères ton propre portefeuille de clients de A à Z. Le cold calling est ton levier quotidien pour convaincre et obtenir des rendez\-vous stratégiques avec des responsables d'entreprise.

Le sens de la conviction : Tu n'hésites pas à donner ton avis, même face à une figure d'autorité. Tu préfères une discussion franche au consensus facile.
Une résilience sans faille : L'échec te pousse à redoubler d'efforts. Un "non" n'est jamais une fin en soi, mais le point de départ pour trouver une autre solution.

Une curiosité naturelle : Tu aimes creuser un sujet pour en comprendre les racines. Tu poses les bonnes questions pour comprendre un problème avant d'agir.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.
Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.
We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers — from first conversation through ongoing engagement.
